title: EU search latency during cache replacement
summary: Search slowed to 4s p99 in the EU for about 20 minutes during a cache node replacement. Expect SEV2.

input.title: EU search latency during cache node replacement
input.incident:
2026-08-27 (UTC)
09:10 Planned replacement of cache node eu-cache-2 begins (maintenance ticket OPS-2291).
09:12 Search p99 latency in eu-west rises from 200 ms to 4.1 s; some requests time out after 5 s.
09:14 Latency alert fires; on-call sees the cache hit rate drop from 94% to 31%.
09:20 Cause identified: the replacement node joined empty and the client hashed 40% of keys to it; no warm-up step.
09:24 Traffic weight for the new node reduced to 10%; latency starts to fall.
09:31 p99 back under 300 ms.
Impact: EU customers saw slow search for about 20 minutes; roughly 6% of searches timed out. Results were correct; no data affected. US regions unaffected.
Notes: the maintenance checklist has no cache warm-up step; the alert fired 2 minutes after impact.
